info.name: ASMO AI Search API v2.1
info.description:
Test cases for the ASMO AI Search API (generated together with the Bruno collection).

1. Set base_url (and, when Keycloak auth is on, keycloak_client_secret, keycloak_username, keycloak_password).
2. Run '00 Auth / A01' to get a token (skip when KEYCLOAK_AUTH_ENABLED=false).
3. File uploads use paths relative to the project folder: set Postman's working directory to ASMO_SEARCH_CODE (Settings > General > Working directory).
